name: tmux-status-dots
description: Shows Claude's state (working, needs you, idle, error) on its tmux window and iTerm2 tab

itermDot.title: iTerm2 tab dot
itermDot.description: When tmux runs in iTerm2, show Claude's state as the colored dot on the iTerm2 tab. Uses iTerm2's own it2 tool. Turn off to leave iTerm2 alone.

itermLayout.title: iTerm2 tab layout
itermLayout.description: two-line: the task on top, the state (working, waiting, idle) under it. one-line: the state goes after the task, like "Fix login: working" (needs #{@claude_label} in your tmux set-titles-string, see README).
